title: CIP Safety: Display human readable timestamps
description:
1. Time Coord Msg Min Multiplier, Network Time Expectation Multiplier, Max Data Age: Show as ms, instead of 'number of 128us ticks'
2. Time Correction EPI: Show as ms, instead of us

notes.body:
added 12 commits

[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/6689/diffs?diff_id=373308748&start_sha=9b81cd4436aeec34737e1586eaa0dfa181adeeb9)
